description: Activity and availability of the 5chan boards monitored by Bitsocial.

options.content:
Network overview  ·  5chan boards  ·  Seedit communities

Activity and availability of the 65 boards in the official 5chan directories.

panels.description: Boards whose latest fetch succeeded and whose latest update is less than 2 hours old.

targets.expr: sum(((max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_last_community_update_fetch_seconds_since_updated_at{client_id="5chan"}) < bool 7200) * max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_last_community_update_fetch_success{client_id="5chan"})) or (max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_last_community_update_fetch_success{client_id="5chan"}) * 0))
